species.name: Marine Iguana
mustRead: blunt square salt-crusted snout
laterally flattened paddle-like swimming tail
low spiny crest and long curved claws
species.note: stubby blunt face and dark sooty body - not the long pointed green-iguana profile

species.name: Land Iguana
mustRead: heavy jowly yellow-orange head
spiny crest along the nape and back
thick round tapering tail and stout clawed legs

species.name: Blind Salamander
mustRead: blood-red feathery external gills
chalk-white unpigmented skin
spindly toothpick legs
species.note: Interpreted as the Texas blind salamander / olm type. Eyes are absent or buried under skin - never draw open eyes; the head is broad and flat, not pointed.

species.name: Cow
mustRead: heavy sagging barrel body with visible udder
hanging throat dewlap
sideways-set ears with tufted tail

species.name: Bull
mustRead: massive humped neck and shoulder mass
short forward-curving horns
heavy pendulous dewlap

species.name: Horse
mustRead: long arched neck with crest mane
single hoof on each long slim leg
long flowing tail from a high dock

species.name: Donkey
mustRead: very long upright ears
short upright bristly mane
cow-like tail tufted only at the tip
species.note: Straighter back, bigger head and shorter neck than a horse; no flowing forelock.

species.name: Pig
mustRead: flat round snout disc
deep barrel body on very short legs
curly corkscrew tail

species.name: Llama
mustRead: long banana-curved ears
long upright S-curved neck
flat back with no hump
species.note: A camelid with no hump - larger, longer-faced and less woolly than an alpaca.

species.name: Alpaca
mustRead: dense woolly fleece covering the whole body
blunt short face under a topknot fringe
short straight spear-shaped ears

species.name: Dog
mustRead: muzzle ending in a black nose
erect or folded ears
plumed tail carried above the back
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a mid-sized domestic dog of no particular breed.

species.name: Koala
mustRead: huge round fluffy ears
large spoon-shaped black nose
no visible tail, gripping a vertical trunk
species.note: Not a bear - the nose is enormous and leathery and the eyes are small and beady.

species.name: Platypus
mustRead: flat rubbery duck-like bill
broad flat paddle tail
webbed clawed feet on a low sleek body
species.note: The bill is soft and fleshy and fused into the face - not a hard bird beak stuck on.

species.name: Echidna
mustRead: dome of long cream-and-black spines
short tubular beak-snout with no visible mouth
stocky splayed digging claws

species.name: Wombat
mustRead: stout barrel body with no visible tail
broad blunt bare-nosed snout
short powerful bowed digging legs

species.name: Tasmanian Devil
mustRead: oversized blocky head and gaping jaws
black fur with a white chest band
thick short tapering tail on a low stocky body

species.name: Sugar Glider
mustRead: skin membrane stretched from wrist to ankle
huge black eyes with dark facial stripe to the nose
long bushy tail as long as the body

species.name: Quoll
mustRead: white spots scattered over the back and the tail
pointed pink snout
long bushy tail on a low slinking body
species.note: Unlike most spotted mammals the spots continue onto the tail.

species.name: Komodo Dragon
mustRead: heavy limbs splayed out sideways
long muscular tail about half the total length
long forked yellow tongue and loose scaly neck skin

species.name: Chameleon
mustRead: cone eye turrets that swivel independently
tail coiled into a tight spiral
laterally flattened leaf-shaped body with a helmet casque
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a veiled/panther chameleon type. Body is compressed side to side, so a side profile is the tall view.

species.name: Gila Monster
mustRead: beaded bumpy black-and-orange skin
fat sausage-shaped fat-storing tail
blunt heavy head on a thick neck

species.name: Axolotl
mustRead: three pairs of feathery external gill stalks
wide flat head with an upcurved smiling mouth
fin crest running along tail and back
species.note: Stays larval for life - it keeps four small legs plus the gills; never draw it as a metamorphosed salamander.

species.name: Frilled Lizard
mustRead: huge circular skin frill fanned out behind the head
very long whip tail over half the length
gaping pink mouth at the frill's centre

species.name: Tree Shrew
mustRead: long pointed squirrel-like snout
bushy tail as long as the body
small clawed grasping feet on a slim low body
